# Amendments Nature Immunology

Nature Immunology | VOL 20 | NOVEMBER 2019 | 1555–1556 | www.nature.com/natureimmunology 1556

Author Correction: Subsets of exhausted CD8+ T cells differentially mediate tumor control and respond to checkpoint blockade

Brian C. Miller , Debattama R. Sen , Rose Al Abosy , Kevin Bi, Yamini V. Virkud, Martin W. LaFleur , Kathleen B. Yates, Ana Lako, Kristen Felt, Girish S. Naik, Michael Manos, Evisa Gjini, Juhi R. Kuchroo, Jeffrey J. Ishizuka, Jenna L. Collier , Gabriel K. Griffin, Seth Maleri, Dawn E. Comstock, Sarah A. Weiss, Flavian D. Brown, Arpit Panda, Margaret D. Zimmer, Robert T. Manguso, F. Stephen Hodi, Scott J. Rodig, Arlene H. Sharpe and W. Nicholas Haining

Correction to: Nature Immunology https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-019-0312-6 (2019), published online 18 February 2019.

In the version of this article initially published, a foundation in the Acknowledgements section was identified incorrectly (Mathers Charitable Trust). The name correct name is ‘The G. Harold and Leila Y. Mathers Charitable Foundation’. The error has been corrected in the HTML and PDF versions of the article.

Published online: 3 October 2019 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-019-0528-5

Author Correction: Tubular cell and keratinocyte single-cell transcriptomics applied to lupus nephritis reveal type I IFN and fibrosis relevant pathways

Evan Der, Hemant Suryawanshi, Pavel Morozov, Manjunath Kustagi, Beatrice Goilav, Saritha Ranabothu, Peter Izmirly, Robert Clancy, H. Michael Belmont, Mordecai Koenigsberg, Michele Mokrzycki, Helen Rominieki, Jay A. Graham , Juan P. Rocca, Nicole Bornkamp, Nicole Jordan, Emma Schulte, Ming Wu, James Pullman , Kamil Slowikowski , Soumya Raychaudhuri , Joel Guthridge , Judith James, Jill Buyon , Thomas Tuschl , Chaim Putterman and the Accelerating Medicines Partnership Rheumatoid Arthritis and Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (AMP RA/SLE) Consortium

Correction to: Nature Immunology https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-019-0386-1, published online 20 May 2019.

In the version of this article initially published, an author surname (Ranabathou) was incorrect. The correct surname is ‘Ranabothu’. The error has been corrected in the HTML and PDF versions of the article.

Published online: 11 October 2019 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-019-0529-4

## Author Correction: ‘Stealth’ corporate innovation: an emerging threat for therapeutic drug development

Taylor , Alberto Mantovani , John P. A. Ioannidis and John D. Lambris

Correction to: Nature Immunology https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-019-0503-1, published online 27 September 2019.
